challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.subtitle: 🎯 Dive into our coding challenges to have fun and acquire new skills.
challenges.promoText: Challenges offer an easy way to test your understanding and pick up some additional skills along the way.
challenges.addEntry: Add your entry to the challenge
challenges.addEntryDesc: Put your coding skills to the test and share your answer with everyone. We're excited to see what you've come up with.
challenges.discussVoteDesc: Explore the diverse solutions from our community. Share your thoughts through comments, ask questions, and appreciate great code by casting your vote for the best entry.
challenges.awardsDesc: Your brilliant solutions earn you special recognition! We'll be highlighting top contributors and insightful approaches, so put your best code forward.
challenges.interested: Are you interested in Challenges on Stack Overflow?
challenges.rule1: Your solution must be original work
challenges.rule3: Code should be runnable without external dependencies
challenges.rule4: One entry per person (you can edit your submission)
challenges.writeSolution: Write your solution here... (supports markdown and code blocks)
challenges.guideline1Body: Use challenges to gain new skills and engage with the community to share your take on the answer! Keep your entries on topic for the best chance to win.
challenges.guideline2Body: Cast your upvote for the best answer! See all entries once the voting period starts. Or, submit your own now for an early comparison.
challenges.guideline3Body: We expect all users to treat one another with kindness and respect. Remember, everyone is here to learn, and sometimes while learning, people make mistakes.
challenges.guideline4Body: Challenges are not for sharing your resume or job listing.
challenges.guideline5Body: If your post happens to be about your product or website, you must disclose your affiliation. See spam guidelines and best practices.
